cast.title: Brooklyn's Finest
cast.overview: Enforcing the law within the notoriously rough Brownsville section of the city and especially within the Van Dyke housing projects is the NYPD's sixty-fifth precinct. Three police officers struggle with the sometimes fine line between right and wrong.

cast.title: The Final Mission
cast.overview: Three criminal friends on the run and evading capture try to find out who might have provided their secret information to law enforcement.

cast.title: Hug
cast.overview: Drew is a virtuoso musical talent with a music contract ready to sign. Asa, his friend and manager, must physically get Drew to the contract signing. When Asa realizes that Drew has gone off his meds, the morning commute turns troubling.

cast.title: Rock the Paint
cast.overview: A coming-of-age story ignites when teenager Josh Sendler has to pack up his hoop dreams and move from the lush cornfields of Indiana to the harsh inner-city playgrounds of Newark, N.J.. He meets and befriends basketball phenom, Antwon Jackson, on the local court and together they make a run for the high school state championship. Their friendship is tested along the way and ultimately must prove itself in the face of the explosive n-word.

cast.title: Officer Down
cast.overview: When a cop's crooked past comes back to get him, can he do the right thing, or will he succumb to the threats of his dangerous connections?

cast.title: Love Beats Rhymes
cast.overview: A young woman dreams of making it big in the world of hip hop, but her parents demand that she finish her university degree. She dutifully agrees to complete her education, but her spoken word proves to have a powerful impact in the classroom.

cast.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - The Introduction
cast.original_title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - The Introduction
cast.overview: Tension builds as threats are carried out, stakes are raised and communication breaks down. In Los Santos a drive-by shooting in Grove Street Family's territory ignites a series of events in the days leading up to the start of the game.

cast.title: Pain and Suffering: A Legal Comedy
cast.original_title: Pain and Suffering: A Legal Comedy
cast.overview: LENNY ROSEN is a struggling personal injury attorney. He gets a case that everyone else thinks is a stinker, but Lenny is convinced will get him a million dollar verdict and into the "Million Dollar Club".
